notes: This contract pins the official C++ surfaces used by the bounded changed-lookahead re-enable slice for timestamped Update Attribute Values. A producer queues one timestamped update while regulating with lookahead one, disables regulation, re-enables it with lookahead three, verifies Query Lookahead, and advances to establish the new GALT boundary before a constrained recipient's Reflect Attribute Values and Time Advance Grant callbacks. The queued passel, callback metadata, and retraction classification are preserved across the role transition. This is development-profile evidence only; it does not claim remote transport, save/restore, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, validation, interoperability, or conformance.
